jobs.title: Head of Cyber Underwriting, North America
jobs.why: Core-domain and a genuine step up: running cyber underwriting for a major carrier across North America. The most directly relevant role surfaced today.

jobs.title: Risk Manager, Equities
jobs.comp: not disclosed; HRT comp is typically well above insurance bands
jobs.why: In-house risk at a top-tier prop trading firm in NYC. A sideways move on title but likely a large step up on comp — worth a look purely on that basis.

jobs.title: Director, Regulatory Risk — Financial Services
jobs.location: New York, NY (hybrid, 3 days on site)
jobs.why: Consulting-side risk leadership in NYC. Advisory rather than in-house, but the regulatory-risk focus maps closely onto your underwriting background.

jobs.title: Director, Business Operations (Risk Management)
jobs.why: Owns the operational resilience framework — third-party risk, incident response planning, business continuity. Exactly the in-house risk profile you asked to see surfaced.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Enterprise Risk Programs and Intelligence
jobs.why: Senior ERM leadership in a fintech environment. Posted through a talent platform rather than the employer directly, so confirm who the actual hiring company is before investing time.

jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Risk Management
jobs.why: Building the ERM architecture from the ground up at a healthcare company — a founding-seat version of the in-house risk role. Healthcare rather than tech, but the mandate is broad.

cyber_intel.headline: One ransomware crew now drives half of all cyber claims
cyber_intel.note: Concentration like that is a portfolio problem, not a claims problem — a single group's tooling change moves your whole loss ratio.

cyber_intel.headline: 73% of 2025 ransomware attacks began at a VPN, SonicWall linked to 27% of claims
cyber_intel.note: First time SonicWall has topped the list. A concrete underwriting question to be asking on every submission.

cyber_intel.headline: Salesloft-Drift OAuth breach hits 700 firms
cyber_intel.note: SaaS supply-chain exposure that insurers now have to treat as systemic rather than idiosyncratic.

cyber_intel.headline: Allianz reports cyber claim severity down 50% in 2025 as large firms harden
cyber_intel.note: Cuts against the Lockton severity data — the divergence is large corporates improving while SMEs absorb the damage.

cyber_intel.headline: New York DFS fines eight auto insurers $19m over weak cyber controls
cyber_intel.note: Regulator going after insurers' own security, not their insureds'. Relevant to any carrier operating in NY.

cyber_intel.headline: Invision Cyber launches US book with $10m limits behind Lloyd's syndicates
cyber_intel.note: Prices off Trend Micro telemetry — another entrant tying premium directly to observed security posture.

cyber_intel.headline: Ransomware crews now attach AI-generated legal exposure reports to ransom notes
cyber_intel.note: Manufactured estimates of regulatory fines and breach scope, used to raise pressure to pay.

cyber_intel.headline: Global insurtech funding up 19.5% to $5.1bn
cyber_intel.note: Capital still arriving despite the soft rate environment.

uk_news.headline: Burnham and Healey scrap VAT on household electricity from October
uk_news.note: Cut from 5% to zero, funded by scrapping the Digital ID programme.

uk_news.headline: Healey inherits government debt at roughly 100% of annual output
uk_news.note: Borrowing costs sit above most other advanced economies — the binding constraint on everything else he wants to do.

uk_news.headline: Burnham becomes the UK's seventh prime minister in ten years
uk_news.note: Pledging rapid house building alongside cost-of-living measures.

uk_news.headline: Bank of England holds Bank Rate at 3.75%, MPC split 6-3
uk_news.note: Decision taken 30 July; rates could still rise if Middle East energy pressure persists.

uk_news.headline: CPI inflation fell to 2.6% in June from 2.8%
uk_news.note: Bailey called the relief temporary given volatile energy prices — and oil has since turned back up.

uk_news.headline: Budget confirmed for 28 October
uk_news.note: Lands alongside a fresh OBR forecast, and will be Healey's first.

uk_news.headline: FSB Small Business Index at a record low net balance of -14%
uk_news.note: Just 18% of small firms expect to grow; 32% expect to shrink, sell or close.

premier_league.headline: Season opens 21 August, pushed back a week by the summer World Cup
premier_league.note: Arsenal defend the title; the final matchweek shifts back correspondingly.

premier_league.headline: Arteta confirms Saliba and Timber will miss the start
premier_league.note: Timber still weeks from full training, Saliba told to rest a fortnight — both centre-halves out for the opener.

premier_league.headline: Joe Gomez out around a month with a muscle injury
premier_league.note: Picked up in Liverpool's first pre-season match; misses the opener against Newcastle.

premier_league.headline: Bournemouth lose Eli Junior Kroupi for three to four months
Transfer window closes 1 September at 11pm
premier_league.note: Three weeks left; Leeds have already broken the British goalkeeper record for James Trafford.

f1.headline: Summer break — racing resumes at Zandvoort, 21-23 August
f1.note: Nothing on track for another ten days.

f1.headline: Antonelli leads the championship on 219 points
f1.note: Hamilton second on 169, Russell third on 160.

f1.headline: Norris took his first win of the season in Hungary
f1.note: Started on pole, was jumped by Piastri at the start, then took it back.

f1.headline: Hamilton 50 points adrift going into the second half
f1.note: A two-win gap with ten rounds still to run.

nba.headline: Kawhi Leonard traded to Toronto — but the deal is frozen
nba.note: Clippers get Ingram, Gradey Dick, two firsts, two seconds and a swap. On hold pending the league's investigation into impermissible benefits; Leonard expects to be a Raptor by training camp.

nba.headline: Donovan Mitchell signs a four-year, $273m max extension with Cleveland
Lakers confirm LeBron James is leaving after eight years
nba.note: Franchise released a statement on the departure.

nba.headline: Ja Morant to Portland for Jerami Grant and Kris Murray
nba.note: Memphis moves on from its franchise guard.

nba.headline: Giannis Antetokounmpo to Miami headlines the offseason
nba.note: Four players, four first-round picks and a swap went to Milwaukee.

notes.jobs: Six roles today, all linking to the employer's own posting rather than a job-board search page — the search change made after yesterday's thin edition.
